clue.text: Poorly triangulated, lowering quality

indicators.note: something done poorly is botched, so the word's letters end up out of their proper order

parts.note: taken as written: twelve letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A surveyor's badly done triangulation spoils the quality of the map.
explanation.definitionFit: To adulterate is to debase something by adding inferior material, so adulterating is the act of lowering its quality.

clue.text: A Post Office vault briefly held endless rarely encountered, hidden or secret things

definitions.text: rarely encountered, hidden or secret things

indicators.note: said briefly, the word is cut short and loses its final letter
without an end, the word drops its last letter

parts.note: a crypt is an underground vault; shortened by one letter
held is HAD, missing its last letter

explanation.surface: A post office strongroom holds unusual, concealed secrets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rarely encountered' flags a rare dictionary sense: the Greek root means hidden things, beyond the usual meaning of doubtful scriptures.
explanation.definitionFit: In its rare, etymological sense the Greek-derived word denotes things concealed or kept secret, as opposed to books of disputed authorship.

clue.text: University student with revolutionary skill way beyond norm

parts.note: a learner, as on an L-plate

indicators.note: a revolution turns something right round, so the word is read from the other end

explanation.surface: A university student with radical talents who stands out far above average.
explanation.definitionFit: As a prefix or adjective it means extreme, going beyond what is normal or ordinary.

clue.text: Sensitivity with feelings about grief at heart unspoken

indicators.note: about means around, so one word wraps the other

parts.note: tact is sensitivity to others' feelings

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its central letter, which is all that is kept

parts.note: the middle letter of the five

explanation.surface: Tactful sensitivity around someone's grief, left unsaid.
explanation.definitionFit: Tacit means understood or implied without being stated aloud in words.

clue.text: Learning again about ruminant's stomach in middle of slaughter

parts.note: the read (or reed) is a cow's fourth stomach, the abomasum

indicators.note: the middle of a nine-letter word is its fifth letter, the only one kept

explanation.surface: Something about a cow's stomach in the middle of an abattoir.
explanation.walkthrough: READ for the fourth stomach is an obscure Chambers word; the surface makes it look like butchery.
explanation.definitionFit: Rereading means studying a text a second time, which amounts to learning it again.

clue.text: At best all used this seasoning

indicators.note: used here means worn or knocked about, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A cook's advice that, at best, everybody used this one condiment.
explanation.definitionFit: Table salt is the commonest seasoning, sprinkled on food at meals.

clue.text: Tides rising extend across surrounding shingle finally

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means read from bottom to top
surrounding means placed around, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to span is to extend across

indicators.note: finally keeps just the last letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: Rising tides stretch over the shingle beach.
explanation.walkthrough: E goes inside SPAN to make SPAEN, which is then turned upside down.
explanation.definitionFit: Neaps are neap tides, the smallest tides of the lunar month, at the quarter moons.

clue.text: Manoeuvred cargo ship alee in these seas abounding in islands

indicators.note: manoeuvred means moved about, so the letters are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: A cargo ship steered downwind through island-studded waters.
explanation.definitionFit: Archipelago originally named the Aegean, a sea full of islands, and now means any such sea or island group.

clue.text: Concerning publicity, impartial workers regularly test alterations

indicators.note: regularly means at even intervals, taking every other letter

explanation.surface: Regarding advertising, fair-minded staff routinely trial changes.
explanation.definitionFit: Readjustments are small modifications made to get something right again, so they are alterations.

clue.text: Where one can drop off jumpers, centre for donations

indicators.note: the centre of a nine-letter word is its fifth letter, which alone is kept

explanation.surface: A charity drop-off point for knitted jumpers, the hub for donations.
explanation.walkthrough: Jumpers look like sweaters left at a charity shop, but they are kangaroos; 'drop off' means fall asleep.
explanation.definitionFit: A roost is a perch where birds settle to sleep, i.e. where one drops off.

clue.text: Changing sides, do something enjoyable, exercise the mind

indicators.note: the two sides are left and right, so one side's letter is swapped for the other

parts.note: to celebrate is to mark an occasion with enjoyment

explanation.surface: Switching teams, have fun, and give your brain a workout.
explanation.walkthrough: L (left) in CELEBRATE becomes R (right), giving CEREBRATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To cerebrate is to think, use the brain, from Latin cerebrum.

clue.text: Blood alcohol level of woman before meal and hot drink

indicators.note: before places one piece in front of the next one

parts.note: a woman is referred to as her
tea is an evening meal in Britain

explanation.surface: A woman's blood alcohol reading taken before dinner and a warming drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Level of woman' reads as the woman's level, so the pronoun comes first; in Britain 'tea' can be the evening meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Herbal tea is an infusion of herbs in boiling water, drunk hot.

clue.text: Relieved and satisfied, quitting place

indicators.note: quitting means leaving, so those letters depart from the word

parts.note: PL is the abbreviation for place in addresses

explanation.surface: Someone relieved and content to be leaving a spot.
explanation.definitionFit: If pain is eased it is relieved or alleviated, so the two past participles are synonyms.

clue.text: Those capturing soldier tucked into cooked pizza

indicators.note: tucked into means slipped inside another word
cooking changes something, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A soldier tucking into a cooked pizza.
explanation.walkthrough: PIZZA is rearranged as PAZZI and the soldier goes in after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Paparazzi are photographers who chase celebrities to capture them on camera.

clue.text: Hilariously cunning following uproar over uniform

indicators.note: following means coming after, so this word goes last

parts.note: O is the cricket abbreviation for an over
U is Uniform in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: Wittily devious behaviour after a fuss over school uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: A riotous comedy is hugely funny, so riotously can mean hilariously.

clue.text: With boozing essentially having replaced clubs, collapsed, intoxicated

indicators.note: replaced means one letter is put in another's place

parts.note: to conk out is to collapse

indicators.note: the essence of a word is its central letter, which is all that is kept

parts.note: C is the card abbreviation for clubs

explanation.surface: After drinking replaced nightclubbing, someone keeled over drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: The C of CONKED OUT is swapped for Z.
explanation.definitionFit: Zonked out is slang for being completely stupefied by drink or drugs.

clue.text: Stop working in African Union. Goodbye!

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: a machine that dies stops working

explanation.surface: A walkout in the African Union, and a farewell.
explanation.definitionFit: Adieu is French-derived farewell, used in English as goodbye.

clue.text: Put a slant on it! Wonderland's girl is inside

indicators.note: inside places this piece within the name

parts.note: the heroine of Alice in Wonderland

explanation.surface: A command to spin a story, with Alice from Wonderland inside it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It' does double duty: it completes the instruction in the definition and also supplies its own letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To italicise is to print in sloping italic type, literally putting a slant on the letters.

clue.text: Score after equaliser on the counter? Spain dropping out as Colombia's level?

indicators.note: counter suggests counter-clockwise, running the opposite way, so the phrase is read backwards
dropping out means leaving, so that letter is removed

parts.note: after an equaliser the score might be one-all
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: A football commentator wondering whether Colombia have drawn level after Spain go out.
explanation.definitionFit: A llano is a level, treeless grassy plain, especially in Colombia and Venezuela.

clue.text: Agent into haggling?

indicators.note: haggling is back-and-forth bargaining, so the letters are worked over into a new order

explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition: an agent who is into haggling.
explanation.definitionFit: A negotiant is one who negotiates, a dealer or agent who bargains on others' behalf.

clue.text: One in Mexico perhaps travelling across America in pursuit of good fertiliser

indicators.note: in pursuit of means following behind, so this piece comes second
travelling across means spanning another piece, so it wraps around it

explanation.surface: A Mexican crossing America after a good fertiliser.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' marks UNO as Spanish generally, Mexico being one example.
explanation.definitionFit: Guano, accumulated seabird or bat droppings, is a prized natural fertiliser.

clue.text: What is heard of Saudi oligarchs

indicators.note: of here means taken from within, so the letters sit inside the phrase

explanation.surface: Rumours overheard about rich Saudi businessmen.
explanation.definitionFit: Audio is sound, the part of a recording or broadcast that is heard rather than seen.

clue.text: Fastidious old question I put in place

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
QU is the abbreviation for question

explanation.surface: A finicky old query I put in place.
explanation.definitionFit: Exquisite can mean acutely discriminating or refined in taste, near to fastidious.

clue.text: Inquire into Queens, NYC rejecting outsiders

indicators.note: rejecting the outsiders throws away the first and last letters

parts.note: two queens: QU, the abbreviation for queen, and ER, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: Investigate the New York borough of Queens, which shuns outsiders.
explanation.walkthrough: Queens looks like the New York borough, but it is plural queens.
explanation.definitionFit: To query a claim is to question or investigate it, so the verb matches inquire into.

clue.text: For starters it might be uphill, even steep

indicators.note: starters are the opening letters, so the first letter of each word is kept

explanation.surface: A hill walker's warning that the start could be uphill, even steep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Steep' looks like a description of the hill but it is the verb meaning to soak.
explanation.definitionFit: To steep something is to saturate or soak it, as is to imbue it with dye or a quality.

clue.text: Conclude very large deal successfully for medical instrument

parts.note: OS means outsize, a clothing size

explanation.surface: Wrapping up a huge, successful business deal for medical equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: An endoscope is a flexible tube with a camera, used by doctors to look inside the body.

clue.text: Formed an objection involving current leader of Labour

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the objection surrounds the other letters

parts.note: I is the physics symbol for electric current

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: An objection raised that involved the current Labour leader; Labour is a main British political party.
explanation.definitionFit: Built means constructed or shaped, the same as formed.

clue.text: Lonely type, he developed this material

indicators.note: developed means worked up into something new, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A solitary inventor who came up with a new material.
explanation.definitionFit: Polyethylene, or polythene, is a common plastic material used for bags and packaging.
